logical_contracts.name: BuildConfiguration
logical_contracts.invariant: Sphinx config is validated, serializes only intended client-safe fields, and has explicit ownership.
logical_contracts.verification: config inventory + serialization tests

logical_contracts.name: ClientSafeSerialization
logical_contracts.invariant: Generated client/export serialization excludes production secrets and never interprets untrusted conversation bytes as executable content; persistent browser storage excludes credentials.
logical_contracts.verification: Runs 1–2: secret stripping/storage migration + canonical sanitized snapshot + HTML raw-text isolation; Run 16.2 current self-contained output is reviewed inert base64 data HTML while c2 remains compatibility-only; server/log/prompt gates remain

logical_contracts.name: BrowserRuntime
logical_contracts.invariant: Browser owns presentation/state only; security decisions remain server-enforced.
logical_contracts.verification: browser/service bypass tests

logical_contracts.name: RepresentationProducer
logical_contracts.invariant: The assistant emits the canonical static representation at build-finished; the browser consumes it for VIEW and ASK AI, and never presents a browser conversion as canonical.
logical_contracts.verification: producer contract exit criteria; COPY(static) and ASK AI resolve to identical content

logical_contracts.name: PromptAuthority
logical_contracts.invariant: Server owns system policy; client/page content cannot set authoritative system role.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 4 typed-contract tests across HF proxy, Worker, dev proxy, and direct model service

logical_contracts.name: EndpointDiscovery
logical_contracts.invariant: Public discovery is schema-versioned, client/server drift-tested, and privacy-minimized to coarse capability/readiness signals rather than backend/storage/credential topology.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 5 discovery contract + browser/storage compatibility tests

logical_contracts.name: ProxyRouting
logical_contracts.invariant: Server credentials are destination-bound to approved upstreams.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 4 Path 1/2/3 credential matrix + destination/redirect tests

logical_contracts.name: CorsOriginPolicy
logical_contracts.invariant: Production CORS is explicit least privilege; parallel relays match policy.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 11 B27 exact-origin/default-deny browser matrix

logical_contracts.name: ShareAuthorization
logical_contracts.invariant: Read ID/capability does not imply edit/delete authority.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 3 Global Share separate read/edit capability + PATCH/DELETE authorization tests

logical_contracts.name: ClientIdentity
logical_contracts.invariant: Forwarded identity is accepted only from trusted proxy boundary.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 11 B27 direct-peer default, explicit trusted-XFF opt-in, cross-route helper matrix

logical_contracts.name: RequestLimits
logical_contracts.invariant: Body/resource limits prevent pre-validation memory exhaustion.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 11 B27 Content-Length precheck + incremental streaming ceilings + dev pre-read bound

logical_contracts.name: ModelServicePolicy
logical_contracts.invariant: Direct model endpoint enforces role/policy invariants independently of UI.
logical_contracts.verification: test_model_service_authority.py + contract-copy parity

logical_contracts.name: FeedbackProvenance
logical_contracts.invariant: Persisted feedback/training data has consent/provenance and is never implicitly trusted.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 6: minimal telemetry + versioned consent + quarantine/delete/review + eligible-only dataset tests

logical_contracts.name: SettingsRegistry
logical_contracts.invariant: Client settings have one validated schema/write path with explicit persistence and sensitivity.
logical_contracts.verification: Node registry tests + integration guard

logical_contracts.name: CorpusBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Corpus owns retrieval/evidence semantics; assistant consumes published retrieval contracts.
logical_contracts.verification: import/boundary tests

logical_contracts.name: MCPBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: MCP owns protocol transport; assistant does not invent parallel MCP semantics.
logical_contracts.verification: integration boundary tests

logical_contracts.name: RuntimeHtmlFallback
logical_contracts.invariant: DOM conversion remains observable fallback during staged static migration, not canonical target.
logical_contracts.verification: fallback-selection tests

logical_contracts.name: ServiceParity
logical_contracts.invariant: Alternative service paths cannot bypass auth/CORS/routing/model-policy/privacy controls.
logical_contracts.verification: Runs 4-5 + Run 11 B27 close bundled prompt/log/CORS/application-buffering parity; strict distributed limiter remains deployment residual SEC-P0-31

logical_contracts.name: ShareConversationUX
logical_contracts.invariant: Five live export formats share one shell, one canonical snapshot/serializer registry, sheet-level destination/content state, and stale-safe async result behavior.
logical_contracts.verification: B16 + B24 source/DOM/parser/mutation gates

logical_contracts.name: PrivacyDataLifecycle
logical_contracts.invariant: User conversation/personal data is minimized, purpose-bound, retention-bounded, non-identifying by default, and deletion/withdrawal semantics are truthful.
logical_contracts.verification: Runs 5-7 + Run 12 B28 + Run 16 B32: privacy minimization, explicit consent/review, local durable receipt option, shared atomic receipt authority when required, uncertainty-safe promotion/withdrawal, training tombstones/current-view cleanup; provider-history/global erasure and external Redis persistence remain separate residuals

logical_contracts.name: SensitiveEgressPreflight
logical_contracts.invariant: Actual browser-controlled inference, Share, and contribution egress is locally reviewed for likely secrets/sensitive data/invisible controls; findings retain no matching values and explicit redaction changes an outbound copy only.
logical_contracts.verification: B23: 45 privacy assertions + 17 DOM assertions + Share conversation race gate + Run 7 mutation positives

logical_contracts.name: ShareArtifactLifecycle
logical_contracts.owner: browser Share sheet + Global Share DELETE capability
logical_contracts.invariant: Every assistant-managed Share artifact has truthful removal semantics; Global links additionally enter a bounded session-scoped public lifecycle ledger so links handed to the user remain trackable across new-chat/reload without persisting edit capability.
logical_contracts.verification: B24 + B25 source/DOM/server/mutation gates; Run 9 ledger/status/revoke-history tests

logical_contracts.name: GlobalShareLifecycleTracking
logical_contracts.owner: browser Share lifecycle + HF/Cloudflare HEAD status route
logical_contracts.invariant: Every Global link handed to the user is tracked in a bounded session-scoped public ledger; mutation capability remains page-memory only; status checks are explicit and content-free; terminal lifecycle state is truthful.
logical_contracts.verification: B25: test_global_share_capability.mjs + test_share_conversation_dom.mjs + test_share_server_authority.py + Run 9 mutants

logical_contracts.name: GlobalShareRecoveryFailClosed
logical_contracts.owner: browser Global recovery + HF/Cloudflare lifecycle routes
logical_contracts.invariant: Reload recovery never restores mutation authority or conversation-derived fields from Web Storage; reason-unknown 404 remains recheckable; unavailable/expired state is detached from implicit PATCH state; unavailable live artifacts preserve distinct Revoke/Forget semantics; confirmed expiry is consistent across lifecycle routes.
logical_contracts.verification: B26: 57 Global capability assertions + 64 lifecycle fake-DOM assertions + expired-delete server test + Run 10 mutants (final package counts in VERIFICATION.md)

logical_contracts.name: DistributedAbuseLimitSemantics
logical_contracts.invariant: Local/process/KV counters are truthfully labeled soft abuse controls; shared/authoritative is claimed only when one configured atomic decision plane owns the stated consistency domain. No limiter is authenticated human identity or billing accounting.
logical_contracts.verification: B27 local/KV bounds + B31 Redis/Durable Object authority, truthful discovery, and fail-closed required-mode tests

logical_contracts.name: ContributionReceiptLifecycle
logical_contracts.owner: HF proxy contribution ledger + dataset withdrawal boundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Contribution receipt authority is capability-hashed; SQLite provides local transactional/restart-durable lifecycle state, Redis provides shared atomic lifecycle authority when explicitly required, promotion ambiguity is non-promotable, withdrawal suppresses training output, and deletion wording never exceeds active-ledger/current-view evidence.
logical_contracts.verification: B28 Run 12 lifecycle/storage/dataset gates + B32 Run 16 cross-replica/uncertainty/fail-closed shared-authority gates

logical_contracts.name: ShareCapabilityTransport
logical_contracts.owner: browser Global Share transport + HF/Cloudflare fixed viewer/routes
logical_contracts.invariant: Current generated Share URLs keep the public read locator in an exact fragment; current read/status/update/revoke use fixed request paths with bounded body locators and separate edit authority. Legacy capability-bearing paths are compatibility-only.
logical_contracts.verification: B29 fixed transport Python + Worker runtime + browser source/DOM + mutation gates

logical_contracts.name: LegacyShareCompatibilityDrain
logical_contracts.invariant: Current-generation Share objects are ineligible for capability-bearing legacy paths; legacy PATCH cannot extend TTL; fixed update migrates pre-generation objects so the compatibility population only shrinks.
logical_contracts.verification: B30 HF/Worker runtime generation-gate, retired-PATCH, fixed-migration, deprecation/sunset tests

logical_contracts.name: DistributedRateLimitAuthority
logical_contracts.owner: HF proxy Redis authority + Cloudflare Worker Durable Object authority
logical_contracts.invariant: When distributed quota authority is required, every request in the claimed replica/PoP consistency domain consults one atomic per-identity/per-route-family decision plane; identity is HMAC-pseudonymized before shared state and backend failure cannot silently degrade to independent counters.
logical_contracts.verification: B31 Run 15 Python shared-Redis tests + Worker two-PoP Durable Object runtime + fail-closed deployment/config positive controls

logical_contracts.name: SharedContributionReceiptAuthority
logical_contracts.owner: HF proxy Redis contribution ledger + external-provider saga boundary
logical_contracts.invariant: When shared contribution authority is required, all participating replicas consult one atomic Redis receipt domain; receipt identifiers are HMAC-pseudonymized; shared-backend failure fails closed; expired/ambiguous promotion ownership becomes non-promotable reconciliation state rather than being reassigned across unfenced provider side effects.
logical_contracts.verification: B32 Run 16 two-replica semantic authority tests, Lua/source contract tests, shared-required HTTP gate, provider ambiguity/withdrawal recovery tests and positive-control mutants

logical_contracts.name: DatasetContributionPurposeSeparation
logical_contracts.owner: browser feedback/contribution surfaces + HF contribution schema/lifecycle
logical_contracts.invariant: Rating telemetry, Share/export and content-bearing dataset contribution are distinct purposes/control planes; every contribution shortcut converges on one exact-payload privacy/consent controller; whole-conversation schema-v4 intake remains one ordered user/assistant record in the existing quarantine/review/delete/withdraw lifecycle.
logical_contracts.verification: B36 Run 17 source + mini-DOM + schema/lifecycle + positive-control mutation gates

logical_contracts.name: FeedbackTelemetryExplicitPermission
logical_contracts.owner: browser feedback telemetry controller + HF/Worker feedback gates
logical_contracts.invariant: Local rating is not network consent; only current structured browser permission enables feedback telemetry, every official feedback request carries the current consent contract, server/Worker reject missing or malformed consent before persistence, opt-out stops all future feedback traffic including retractions, and the public feedback event is content-free.
logical_contracts.verification: B36 Run 17 feedback telemetry consent execution/source/server tests plus positive-control mutants

logical_contracts.name: RecoverableCreateManagementCapability
logical_contracts.owner: browser Share/contribution operation envelope + HF/Worker lifecycle endpoints
logical_contracts.invariant: Current browser CREATE establishes operation/resource/management authority before transmission, sends only a one-way management-capability digest, binds replay to resource + operation + payload + capability digest, exposes ambiguous results as outcome_unknown, and retries the same envelope; explicit receipt export/import preserves contribution management agency without silent localStorage capability persistence.
logical_contracts.verification: B37 Run 18 Python lifecycle/privacy tests + executable browser/source operation-envelope tests

logical_contracts.name: BrowserOriginPrivacyResidue
logical_contracts.owner: browser feedback integration + transcript/device persistence + runtime endpoint diagnostics
logical_contracts.invariant: Local rating, network telemetry and public DOM integration are separate states; page events require independent current permission and remain content-free, transcript restore is per-tab opt-in and bounded, device identifiers are session-scoped, and endpoint diagnostics exclude query/fragment/userinfo while secret-like query parameters are rejected. Arbitrary same-origin JavaScript remains a trust-boundary residual.
logical_contracts.verification: B37 Run 18 56-assertion browser harness + endpoint/logging/persistence compatibility tests

logical_contracts.name: GlobalShareStorageAuthority
logical_contracts.owner: HF ShareStore + Cloudflare Worker Share storage semantics
logical_contracts.invariant: Memory, SQLite, Redis and Worker KV storage claims reflect their actual durability/sharing/consistency semantics; required HF durable/shared modes fail closed, Redis lifecycle expiry cleanup is atomic, and deterministic Worker KV retry recovery is not mislabeled as linearizable global create-once authority.
logical_contracts.verification: B37 Run 18 ShareStore/Redis service tests + Worker/browser Share contracts and health/discovery assertions

logical_contracts.name: ReproducibleDependencyClosure
logical_contracts.invariant: Production Python dependencies are exact and hash-locked for the declared platform; Docker consumes only the lock; Python SBOM exactly matches lock; immutable identity does not waive fresh vulnerability scanning.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 19 B38 supply-chain tests + offline verify_supply_chain.py; external scan/install evidence remains SEC-P1-38

logical_contracts.name: LeastPrivilegeDeploymentProfile
logical_contracts.owner: _hf_spaces_proxy Dockerfile + app strict startup + hardened reference deployment
logical_contracts.invariant: Release image is platform-bound, builder/runtime separated and non-root; strict startup rejects root/unsafe origins; build context is deny-default and read-only least-privilege deployment is documented.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 19 B38 Docker/policy/strict-startup tests

logical_contracts.name: SharedRedisTransportAuthority
logical_contracts.invariant: Strict Redis uses rediss with certificate and hostname verification and rejects query downgrade options consistently across every shared authority plane.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 19 B38 three-plane Redis transport tests; ACL/persistence/replication remain deployment evidence

logical_contracts.name: ReleaseEvidenceSubjectBinding
logical_contracts.invariant: Production promotion evidence is short-lived, content-addressed and bound to exact dependency lock, Python SBOM, deterministic runtime source, immutable base manifest, final OCI image and matching SLSA provenance; stale/path/symlink/hash/subject/risk-waiver substitution fails closed.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 20 B39 evidence tests + offline verify_supply_chain.py + release_subjects.py; external truth remains SEC-P1-38

logical_contracts.name: InfrastructureTelemetryNonBypass
logical_contracts.owner: release evidence logging posture + application logging/privacy boundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Browser feedback consent never authorizes infrastructure request-body/header/query/WAF/APM capture or third-party telemetry export; hardened promotion requires those channels disabled.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 20 B39 logging/telemetry evidence negatives + existing logging/privacy mutation controls

logical_contracts.name: RedisOperationalEvidenceBoundary
logical_contracts.owner: B38 Redis transport policy + B39 sanitized probe/release evidence
logical_contracts.invariant: Redis authority/topology values never enter evidence output; operational probe is explicit and coarse, while Share/Contribution production promotion separately requires least-privilege, persistence, replication and recent backup/restore evidence.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 20 B39 fake-client sanitization tests + B38 three-plane Redis TLS tests; provider/failover facts remain external SEC-P1-38 evidence

logical_contracts.name: PrivateLifecycleEventBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Internal lifecycle coordination never requires public document events; optional public projections require current page-integration consent and omit sensitive/internal detail.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 21 B40 executable browser isolation + source assertions

logical_contracts.name: OpaqueOriginReadWriteSeparation
logical_contracts.owner: HF proxy + Cloudflare Worker Share CORS guards
logical_contracts.invariant: Origin:null read compatibility and mutation authority are distinct; write requires a second opt-in and strict HF deployment refuses it.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 21 B40 HF/Worker route-method tests

logical_contracts.name: RuntimeBearerCompatibilityDefaultOff
logical_contracts.invariant: Browser bearer-token entry is default Off and centrally enforced; explicit compatibility tokens remain page-memory-only and never enter static HTML or Web Storage.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 21 B40 endpoint-registry executable tests + Python config assertions

logical_contracts.name: SeparateOriginRuntimeIsolation
logical_contracts.invariant: A configured distinct isolation origin suppresses the same-origin assistant and runs UI/transcript/runtime state behind SOP with no silent downgrade.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 22 B41 Python + executable host/frame tests

logical_contracts.name: CapabilityMessageChannelBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Bootstrap validates exact origin/source/version/channel then transfers one bounded monotonic capability MessagePort; unknown/replayed/oversized messages fail closed.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 22 B41 executable browser protocol tests

logical_contracts.name: IsolatedStorageTenantPartition
logical_contracts.invariant: All isolated local/session storage keys are namespaced by validated parent origin plus normalized documentation root rather than relying on browser storage partitioning; separate projects under one parent origin remain distinct.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 22 B41 storage scope assertions + Run 23 B42 docs-root partition test

logical_contracts.name: HostPageContextCapabilityBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Frame receives bounded sanitized page snapshots/canonical Markdown, not arbitrary parent DOM access; hostile parent integrity remains SEC-P1-42.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 22 B41 host adapter + existing privacy/injection gates

logical_contracts.name: IsolatedPublicIntegrationProjection
logical_contracts.owner: B40 projector + B41 page.integration.emit host validation
logical_contracts.invariant: Public lifecycle events in isolated mode still require B40 page-integration consent and are independently type/detail/size validated by the host.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 22 B41 + Run 21 B40 browser tests

logical_contracts.name: BootstrapSnapshotIntegrity
logical_contracts.owner: B41 documentation-origin host bootstrap + isolated frame config scrubber
logical_contracts.invariant: Host snapshots and sanitizes config/endpoints/default before asynchronous HELLO; later page-global mutation cannot alter INIT, secret/prototype-pollution keys are rejected, and null-prototype maps prevent setter-based pollution. Compromise before host startup remains SEC-P1-42.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 22 B41 Python source assertions + executable late-mutation/prototype-pollution browser tests

logical_contracts.name: FrameGeneratedBootstrapAuthority
logical_contracts.invariant: Protocol v2 generates the bootstrap channel in the isolated frame with WebCrypto after policy acceptance; capability is absent from iframe URL and insecure RNG fallback is forbidden.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 23 B42 Python + executable browser handshake tests

logical_contracts.name: IsolationNavigationContainment
logical_contracts.invariant: Isolated runtime cannot self-navigate onto the docs origin while retaining script authority; popup escape/top navigation are absent and HTTP(S) links leave through noopener/noreferrer external navigation.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 23 B42 source + executable click/navigation tests

logical_contracts.name: GeneratedParentOriginPolicy
logical_contracts.owner: Sphinx build generator + isolated frame policy loader
logical_contracts.invariant: Isolation parent authority is a closed-schema exact-origin build artifact with deny-all source default; missing/invalid policy fails before HELLO.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 23 B42 generator + frame policy tests; real headers remain SEC-P1-43

logical_contracts.name: AmbientCredentialEgressBoundary
logical_contracts.owner: browser central fetch transport + docs canonical adapter
logical_contracts.invariant: Assistant-service fetches omit ambient credentials by default and explicit compatibility permits at most same-origin; canonical docs reads are a separately bounded same-origin capability.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 23 B42 executable fetch-wrapper + canonical-read assertions

logical_contracts.name: CrossOriginDeviceDelegationBoundary
logical_contracts.owner: Sphinx config + isolation host iframe allow policy
logical_contracts.invariant: Cross-origin microphone delegation is independent and default Off; unavailable voice UI is suppressed rather than inheriting authority from speech/telemetry/integration settings.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 23 B42 source/config assertions

logical_contracts.name: BoundedCanonicalReadBoundary
logical_contracts.invariant: Canonical reads are same-origin, docs-root bounded, redirect-blocked, cache-bypassed and streaming byte/character limited before complete buffering.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 23 B42 host source assertions + canonical representation tests

logical_contracts.name: PreBufferRemoteResponseCeiling
logical_contracts.invariant: Covered remote response paths reject malformed/declared oversize before parse and enforce actual streamed-byte ceilings before whole-body buffering.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 24 B43 Python + executable browser/Worker tests

logical_contracts.name: StreamCapabilityFailClosed
logical_contracts.invariant: Security-sensitive browser readers do not fall back to whole-body text/json when a bounded stream reader is unavailable.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 24 B43 fail-closed browser tests + Run22/23 stream-capable compatibility fixtures

logical_contracts.name: UpstreamResponseParity
logical_contracts.owner: HF proxy + dev proxy + Cloudflare Worker
logical_contracts.invariant: Chat relay planes use an 8 MiB default / 32 MiB hard upstream response ceiling with predeclared and streamed-byte enforcement.
logical_contracts.verification: Run 24 B43 proxy/Worker tests and config assertions
